members.name: Current
members.summary: The raw state captured this frame.
members.summaryText: The raw state captured this frame.

members.name: Empty
members.summary: An input frame with nothing pressed, used before the first capture and in headless runs.
members.summaryText: An input frame with nothing pressed, used before the first capture and in headless runs.

members.name: IsFocused
members.summary: True while the window has focus. Input reads as idle when it doesn't.

members.name: Mouse

members.summaryText: Mouse position and buttons this frame. Convert the position with Renderer.ScreenToWorld.

members.name: MouseDelta
members.summary: How far the mouse moved since last frame, in pixels. Handy for dragging and camera look.
members.summaryText: How far the mouse moved since last frame, in pixels. Handy for dragging and camera look.

members.name: Previous
members.summary: The raw state captured last frame.
members.summaryText: The raw state captured last frame.

members.name: ScrollDelta
members.summary: Wheel movement since last frame: 120 per notch, positive when scrolling up.

members.name: Text
members.summary: Characters typed since the last frame, already respecting keyboard layout and modifiers. Use it for text entry.

members.name: IsDown
members.summary: True while the key is held. Use it for continuous actions such as movement.
members.summaryText: True while the key is held. Use it for continuous actions such as movement.

members.name: IsDown
members.summary: True while the mouse button is held.
members.summaryText: True while the mouse button is held.

members.name: WasPressed
members.summary: True only on the frame the key goes down. Use it for one-shot actions such as jumping.
members.summaryText: True only on the frame the key goes down. Use it for one-shot actions such as jumping.

members.name: WasPressed
members.summary: True only on the frame the mouse button goes down, such as the start of a click or drag.
members.summaryText: True only on the frame the mouse button goes down, such as the start of a click or drag.

members.name: WasReleased
members.summary: True only on the frame the key comes up.
members.summaryText: True only on the frame the key comes up.

members.name: WasReleased
members.summary: True only on the frame the mouse button comes up, such as the end of a drag.
members.summaryText: True only on the frame the mouse button comes up, such as the end of a drag.

summary: Provides the keyboard, mouse and text state shared by a scene's callbacks for one update.
summaryText: Provides the keyboard, mouse and text state shared by a scene's callbacks for one update.
remarks: Access through Controls in a scene or system. Read transitions and text in Update, and held state for continuous actions. Queries do not consume events: repeated calls in the same frame observe the same transition. Unfocused snapshots are normalized to released controls and empty text.
